libs.note: BH-2091. Where the watchdog worker lives, for every lane that pings it. watchdog_url prints $WATCHDOG_URL or, when it is empty, logs one line per lane per UTC day and returns 1 with no network call. bin/harness-sync.sh seeds this fleet's value into env/global.env from catalog/fleet-watchdog.json via watchdog_url_seed.

knobs.note: BH-2091: the watchdog worker base URL, read ONLY by bin/lib/watchdog-url.sh. Empty = no watchdog call, one log line per lane per day. This fleet's value is seeded into env/global.env by bin/harness-sync.sh from catalog/fleet-watchdog.json (origin-guarded, so a fork stays empty). Not settable from the control plane: a root lane sends the shared secret to this host.
